summary: Oracle filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026 disclosing that Executive Chair and CTO Larry Ellison cancelled his Rule 10b5-1 trading plan to sell Oracle stock, per a September 12, 2026 press release. No shares were sold under the plan prior to termination, and no other sale plans exist. The filing is an Item 8.01 Other Events disclosure with Exhibit 99.1; no financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated. The event is a governance/sentiment signal from a founder-holder, not a special situation; watch for any future Form 144 or 13D/A activity.
